title: Professional Studio Headshot
description: A clean, evenly lit studio headshot on a neutral grey backdrop, with a friendly but composed expression. It is the safe, credible look for company pages, speaker bios and professional profiles.
promptText: Professional studio headshot of a person in their late thirties with a friendly, composed expression, looking straight at the camera with a subtle smile. Even soft studio lighting with a large softbox slightly above and to the left, a gentle fill on the right, and a faint hair light for separation. Seamless mid-grey backdrop. Tailored navy blazer over a white open-collar shirt. 105mm lens, aperture f/4, sharp focus on the eyes, natural skin texture without heavy retouching, neutral colour balance. Vertical 4:5 framing, head and upper chest, eyes in the upper third, clean margins around the shoulders.
imageAlt: Studio headshot of a person in a navy blazer against a grey backdrop
visualNotes: A large soft source above eye level is the classic headshot light because it fills the eye sockets and smooths skin without flattening the face. The mid-grey backdrop sits between black and white, so it never fights with hair or clothing colours.

customize.lighting: For a more dynamic look move the key light further to the side and say 'short lighting'; for the safest result keep the light frontal and even.
customize.camera: Use 85mm for a slightly wider, more approachable perspective. Avoid wide-angle lenses, which exaggerate facial features.
customize.background: A warm beige or a deep blue backdrop changes the personality of the image. For web use, light backdrops usually work better on white pages.
customize.wardrobe: Match the clothing to the industry: crisp shirt and no jacket for tech, structured blazer for finance, soft knitwear for creative roles.
customize.mood: Adjust 'subtle smile' to 'warm, open smile with teeth' for sales and service roles, or 'serious, confident' for legal and executive profiles.
customize.composition: For a square avatar, ask for 'centred, head and shoulders, equal margins' so the crop does not cut the head.
customize.aspectRatio: 4:5 for most profile platforms; 1:1 for avatars. Check each platform's crop before generating.

title: Corporate Profile Photograph
description: An environmental profile photo set in a bright modern office, with soft background blur and a confident three-quarter pose. It suits team pages, 'about us' sections and press kits that need more personality than a plain studio backdrop.
promptText: Corporate profile photograph of a woman in her forties with short silver-streaked hair, standing in a bright modern office with her arms loosely crossed, a confident, approachable smile, body turned three-quarters to the camera. Large windows to her right providing soft daylight, a bright, airy feel, soft out-of-focus desks and plants behind her. Charcoal blazer, light blue shirt, a simple watch. 70mm lens, aperture f/3.2, natural skin tones, neutral clean colour grade, crisp detail on face and clothing. Horizontal 3:2 composition, waist-up, subject on the left third with open office space on the right.
imageAlt: Woman in a charcoal blazer standing in a bright modern office with a soft blurred background
visualNotes: An environmental portrait adds context: the setting tells the viewer what the person does before they read the caption. The prompt keeps the office out of focus so the context supports the person instead of competing with them.

customize.lighting: Add 'subtle fill light on the face' if the window light produces dark shadows, or remove windows for a more controlled, evenly lit interior.
customize.camera: A 35mm lens brings the workspace into sharper view for a more documentary feel; a 100mm lens makes the person stand out more.
customize.background: A workshop, a clinic or a co-working space adapt the same photo to different industries. Choose backgrounds with a recognisable but quiet setting.
customize.wardrobe: Rolled sleeves and a plain shirt suggest a hands-on team; a structured jacket signals leadership. Keep accessories minimal.
customize.mood: 'Approachable smile' can become 'mid-conversation, gesturing slightly' for a more active and human look.
customize.composition: For a vertical team-page crop, change the composition to 'portrait 4:5, subject centred' and reduce the office width.
customize.aspectRatio: 3:2 is ideal for website banners; 4:5 for cards. Mention the ratio in the last sentence of the prompt.

title: Creative Founder Headshot
description: A headshot with personality: a founder in a daylight workshop, hands near the work, warm wooden tones and an easy smile. It fits makers, studio owners and small-business pages where a stiff corporate look would feel wrong.
promptText: Environmental headshot of a bearded man in his early forties wearing a canvas apron over a grey henley, standing in a sunlit ceramics workshop with clay-dusted hands resting on a wooden table, a relaxed, proud half-smile, looking at the camera. Soft daylight from a skylight above and a side window, warm wooden shelves with pottery slightly out of focus behind him. 50mm lens, aperture f/2.8, natural skin texture, warm earthy colour palette, light grain. Vertical 4:5 composition, chest-up to hands, subject centred with the workshop framing him.
imageAlt: Bearded man in an apron in a sunlit ceramics workshop with shelves of pottery
visualNotes: Including hands and a tool of the trade lets the viewer read the profession instantly. Top light from a skylight is gentle on faces and adds a pleasant sheen to work surfaces, so the image feels documentary rather than posed.

customize.lighting: For more drama ask for 'single window light, darker workshop', letting the shelves fall into shadow behind him.
customize.camera: 35mm gives an honest, documentary perspective and includes more of the space. Use 85mm for a tighter, quieter portrait.
customize.background: Replace the ceramics shop with a bakery, a bike workshop or a print studio. Choose one with warm textures and clear tools.
customize.wardrobe: A leather apron, rolled flannel sleeves or a clean work jacket signal different crafts. Avoid visible brand names.
customize.mood: 'Proud half-smile' can be changed to 'focused, looking down at the work' for a candid frame that is not looking at the camera.
customize.composition: For wider banners, step back to 'three-quarter length' and place the subject on one third with the work table filling the rest.
customize.aspectRatio: 4:5 for portrait cards, 16:9 for website headers. Request extra room on the sides for 16:9.
